{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"A merino wool blend coat in a structured cut to the mid-calf with a double-breasted front, color #2a3d40 (Deep Slate), featuring a ribbed hem for warmth.
Worn over it is a high-necked turtleneck sweater made of fine cashmere, an oversized silhouette that drapes softly around the shoulders, in color #e8dcc5 (Warm Beige).
Paired with these is a pair of straight-leg dark denim trousers with a mid-rise waist and minimal stitching, colored #1c1e22 (Near Black), cut from heavy-weight cotton for durability against wind.
On feet are sleek leather ankle boots with a low block heel and a shearling-lined interior, finished in color #5a4b41 (Taupe).
Completed with a soft wool scarf wrapped twice around the neck in a herringbone weave, color #dcbfa6 (Dusty Rose), and matching leather gloves that reach the mid-forearm.

This outfit works perfectly for a brisk, snowy commute because the merino coat provides essential insulation against the -10°C temperature while the oversized cashmere turtleneck adds an extra layer of cozy warmth without bulk under the outer shell. The dark denim trousers are chosen specifically to withstand road salt and wet snow without ruining the fit, ensuring you stay comfortable for your twenty-minute walk from the park to work. The neutral beige and taupe tones create a sophisticated yet understated look that aligns with everyday work dress codes, allowing you to transition seamlessly from the cold morning air into an office environment. Every piece is selected to prioritize protection from the elements while maintaining a polished appearance suitable for a professional setting."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":736,"output_tokens":348},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
